description:
Selected as the St. Louis Blues' first pick in the 2017 NHL Draft, Robert Thomas has proven to be a standout for the franchise. During his rookie season in 2018-19, Thomas netted his first career goal against the Nashville Predators. After a Predators turnover at the blue line, Brayden Schenn sent the puck to Thomas, positioned near the faceoff dot on the far side. Thomas collected the puck, took a quick glance, and fired a wrist shot top shelf on the far side, marking his milestone goal.

description:
In the closing seconds of an Edmonton Oilers power play, defenseman Evan Bouchard launched a slapshot from the point through traffic, scoring his first career goal. Known for his powerful shot from the point, Bouchard was selected 10th overall by the Oilers in the 2018 NHL Draft.

description:
In his second NHL game and first at home, Brady Tkachuk, the fourth overall pick in the 2018 NHL Draft, netted his first career goal. During an Ottawa Senators power play, the feisty and physical forward charged to the net, where the puck deflected off his skate and slipped behind the goalie for his first of two goals in the game. Tkachuk wrapped up his rookie season with 22 goals and 45 points.

description:
Chosen 12th overall in the 2018 NHL Draft by the New York Islanders, Noah Dobson is a smooth-skating, puck-moving defenseman. Following an offensive zone faceoff win, the puck was worked over to Dobson, who sent a shot toward the net through heavy traffic. It deflected off the hand of a Detroit player and into the net, marking Dobson's first career goal.

description:
Drafted by the Boston Bruins in the third round of the 2006 NHL Draft, Brad Marchand scored 21 goals in his first full NHL season in 2010-11, after appearing in 20 games the previous year. On Nov. 3, 2010, Marchand netted his first career goal – a shorthanded effort against the Buffalo Sabres to open the scoring on the road. The Bruins went on to win the Stanley Cup that season, with Marchand contributing 19 points in 25 playoff games.
